title: Performance
searchRate_tooltip: Number of search requests per second across the cluster. Higher values increase CPU and coordinator node requirements.
indexingRate_tooltip: Documents indexed per second. Drives ingest node count and hot-tier node sizing. Typically 80-90% of CPU capacity on hot nodes.
concurrentSearches_tooltip: Maximum simultaneous search requests. Determines coordinating node count and JVM thread pool sizing.
concurrentUsers_tooltip: Number of active Kibana users simultaneously viewing dashboards. Multiplies dashboard query load.
dashboardCount_tooltip: Total number of Kibana dashboard objects. Each dashboard generates background queries at regular intervals per active user.
logSourceCount_tooltip: Number of distinct log sources feeding the cluster. Influences index count and ILM pipeline complexity.
workloadProfile_tooltip: Select the primary use case to auto-tune search fractions, document sizes, and write amplification factors.
